summary: Process rigor controls autonomy but cannot make model behavior transactional; side effects, evidence quality and context selection remain application responsibilities.

points.text: A lease timeout does not stop a paused runner or retract an external API call. Propagate fencing tokens where the resource supports them; otherwise use idempotency keys, effect journals and explicit reconciliation before retry.

Over-modeling every conversational turn as a process step creates ceremony and brittle state machines. Use tracked tasks for durable, consequential or asynchronous work; leave trivial exchanges as messages.
A typed verdict can still be false. Done must be derived from independent acceptance evidence, not selected solely because the model emitted the corresponding label.

Full traceability can conflict with privacy and least-context hand-offs. Store references, hashes and redacted evidence where possible; scope each actor's view and apply retention policy to the process trail.
Compensation is not rollback. A compensating action may be partial, externally visible or fail itself, so it needs a separately claimed step, typed verdict and escalation path.
